title: Animate Lightworks effect parameters with keyframes
note: In Lightworks, park the playhead at a desired frame, enable keyframing on an effect property with its stopwatch icon, and set the property value. Move elsewhere and set another value. Use the Keyframes panel to adjust timing or interpolation curves; not every property supports the same controls.

title: Edit Lightworks keyframes directly on a timeline segment
note: Lightworks can display keyframe animation graphs on timeline segments. Turn keyframe editing on using a track header's Keyframes button, then select the parameter and adjust nodes along the graph. Graph editing does not replace normal clip selection and trimming.

title: Use Lightworks Transform 3D for shot reframing
note: The Lightworks Transform 3D effect adjusts position, scaling, and rotation in 3D axes. Increasing scale makes a punch-in, while a smaller scale creates an inset shot. Check aspect-ratio and crop choices before exporting a differently shaped canvas.
